'''First Resonance''' is the first act in [[Chapter I]] of the [[Main Quests]].

==Steps==
#Head to the Nexus Beacon
#Activate the Nexus Beacon
#Take the elevator to reach the City Hall
#Find Yangyang
#Meet with Yangyang
#Head to the City Hall
#Enter the City Hall
#Follow the receptionist
#Take a seat
#Leave the City Hall and talk to Yangyang
#Reach a suitable place to use Grapple
##(Optional) Ask the kids nearby
#Arrive at Huaxu Academy
#Enter the Academy
#Talk to Mortefi
#Ask Baizhi about what happened
#Talk to Baizhi for your body check-up
#Arrove at the designated area and start Simulation Training
#Complete the 1st round of test
#Complete the 2nd round of test
#Complete the final round of test
#Leave Simulation Training
#..T#.ry..to# leave.◼️.◼️..
#..◼️#.◼️..Lea#ve.◼️.◼️..
#Ask Mortefi about the tokens
#Investigate the surrounding or talk to Mortefi
#Find the parts in Xiangli Yao's workshop
#Deliver the parts to Mortefi
#Investigate where the document is located
#Enter the archives room
#Look for clues about the tokens
#Discuss what you have learned with Yangyang
#Leave the Academy

==Gameplay Notes==
*Completing the "Take a seat" step will award the player {{Item|Black Fruit}}, {{Item|Leaf}}, {{Item|Small Device}}, and {{Item|Sugar Pearl}}.
*Completing the "Ask the kids nearby" optional step will award the player {{Item|Candy}} and the ''[[Rover's Journey]]'' [[trophy]] ''[[Candy Spells Riddle]]''.
* Completing the "..◼️#.◼️..Lea#ve.◼️.◼️.." step will unlock [[Convene]] and grant the [[Resonator]] [[Baizhi]].
*Completing the "Deliver the parts to Mortefi" step will award the player {{Item|Sundial}}.
*Completing the "Look for clues about the tokens" step will award the player {{Item|Archive: "The First Resonator"}} and {{Item|Archive: Sugar Pearl Vaccine and Tacet Discord Outbreak}}.
*Completing the quest will grant the ''[[Rover's Journey]]'' trophy ''[[Thus Spoke the Magistrate: Wordless Message]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|As the city lights twinkle, friendly faces beckon you to join them in the bustling border town. Immerse yourself in its prosperous yet tranquil ambiance.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_3_1.ogg}} '''[[Chixia]]:''' Here we are. [[Jinzhou]]'s [[Nexus Tower]]!
:{{DIcon}} The Nexus Tower?
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_3_3.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Exactly. Lemme see, uh, think of it as Jinzhou's largest server station, or an integration hub. It's something along those lines. I'm not much of a tech person myself.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_3_4.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Long story short, it's a navigator, a defense system, and a regional information center all in one enormous package.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_3_5.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' The smaller ones we ran into earlier are [[Resonance Beacon]]s.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_3_6.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Data is shared between all Beacons. You activate one, and the entire map's data will be relayed to your [[Terminal]]. Pretty nifty, huh?
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_3_7.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Just place your Terminal here.
----
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_5_1.ogg}} '''[[Yangyang]]:''' I have the arrangements in place. [[Rover]], you can come visit the [[Jinhsi|Magistrate]] at any time.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_5_2.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Chixia, do you mind bringing Rover over to the [[City Hall]]?
----
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_1.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Whew. First time seeing such a crowd in front of the City Hall.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_2.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' I was surprised too. I've never seen so many non-staff personnel here before.
:{{DIcon}} Are they all here for an audience with the Magistrate?
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_4.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Most of the people here have applied for an audience, but I heard they've all been turned down.
:{{DIcon}} Turned down by who?
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_8.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Most people were advised to leave by the Magistrate's bodyguard upon sending in their applications. The ones staying here are either trying to apply for some other people, or just too stubborn to leave.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_9.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' The few that made it inside said it only took "one freezing look from Lady [[Sanhua]]", and they were compelled to leave.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_10.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' What kind of description is that? sounds like they've met some snake-haired lady, and got turned into stone.
::{{DIcon}} Who's Sanhua?
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_12.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' She's the Magistrate's personal bodyguard.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_13.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Oh, I've heard of her before. She's the "All-round Death Glare slash Terminator Ice Beauty."
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_14.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' ...That's what the rumors say, at least.
:{{DIcon}} Perhaps the Magistrate is not here yet.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_17.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' There is a small chance she's not in the City Hall, but it is very unlikely for her not to be in Jinzhou.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_18.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Or rather, it's nearly impossible for the Magistrate to leave Jinzhou at all.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_19.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' With her busy schedule, it's already difficult to find any time off. In addition, as the Magistrate of Jinzhou, leaving the land under her jurisdiction without authentication is not allowed.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_20.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Unless she's engaged on a business trip, or... when Jinzhou's safety is under threat.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_21.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Yup, there's gotta be something big if that's the case!
:{{DIcon|Arrow}} It's me they're waiting for.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_15.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' So this is the true confidence of our Rover!
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_16.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' I agree though. So far you've been ticking all the boxes in our Magistrate's description.
:{{DIcon}} Can holographic messages be prerecorded?
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_23.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Sure they can.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_24.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Have you thought of something, Rover?
:{{DIcon}} Perhaps the Magistrate did not know who her guest was.
:{{DIcon}} I'm wondering why the Magistrate wanted to meet her guest in person.
:{{DIcon}} She must have a reason for attracting all this attention.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_28.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' You mean...?
:{{DIcon}} She's not doing this to avoid confusion for her guest.
:{{DIcon}} She should have anticipated the follow-up of her public message.
:{{DIcon}} Still, how does she decide who is her guest, and who is not...
:{{DIcon}} Nothing in particular.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_33.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' I can't really keep up with your thoughts, but I think a meeting with the Magistrate wouldn't hurt.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_34.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Same here. Anyway, our Magistrate's the best lead we have for now, no matter what she has in store for Rover.
:{{DIcon}} I believe so.
:{{DIcon|Option}} What do you think?
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_39.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Huh? Me? I'm just wondering how to take you, Yangyang, and [[Baizhi]] for some chow after this!
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_40.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' But my shift's almost coming up. Dunno if we'll make it...
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_41.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' I don't have anything particular in mind.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_42.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' It was me who... I mean, we took you to Jinzhou. I think we should keep you company, at least while you're here.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_43.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Oh, I see.
:{{DIcon}} What if I am not the person?
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_44.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' VIP or not VIP, special or not special... That doesn't matter at all.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_45.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' ...unless there's money to earn, of course!
:{{DIcon}} What if I am the person?
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_46.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Then that's exactly what we're after!
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_47.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' That means we're on the right track then. You'll be getting your memories back in no time.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_48.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' What do you think, Rover? Are you in a hurry to recover your memories?
:{{DIcon}} Most certainly.
:{{DIcon}} The loss of memory doesn't bother me.
:{{DIcon}} I don't know what to do.
:{{DIcon}} What really matters is how I'll live my life and create new memories.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_53.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' In that case...
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_54.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' How about meeting with the Magistrate first? She may have the answers you're looking for.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_55.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' We are not allowed to go with you. Chixia and I will be right outside the City Hall.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_56.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' We'll be waiting for you.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_7_57.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' That's right, we're not going anywhere! Just give us a shout if anything goes down—Wait, no, we won't be able to hear ya. Plus they've got this rule about not yelling inside the City Hall.
----
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_8_1.ogg}} '''Receptionist:''' Please, follow me.
----
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_20_1.ogg}} '''Receptionist:''' Kindly have a seat.
----
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_21_1.ogg}} '''Receptionist:''' Lady Sanhua will be with you shortly.
----
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_9_2.ogg}} '''??:''' Pleased to make your acquaintance. I apologize for the delay. My name is Sanhua, the bodyguard of Madam Magistrate.
:{{DIcon}} Call me Rover for now.
:{{DIcon}} Hello.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_9_4.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' I regret to inform you that Madam Magistrate is currently away. Prior to her departure, she instructed me to bring you these tokens and a welcome gift.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_5.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Madam Magistrate advised you to explore what these tokens represent during her absence. This may help you acquire the information you desire sooner.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_6.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' I apologize for the inconvenience, but please rest assured: she will be here to meet you in three days' time.
:{{DIcon}} Where is the Magistrate?
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_11.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Sorry... I cannot disclose her whereabouts at this time. Please trust me that she is eagerly looking forward to meeting you in person.
::{{DIcon}} Did something happen to her?
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_13.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Pardon my inability to provide a better answer. Madam Magistrate has a task that she must handle alone, but she has never for one moment forgotten about her meeting with you.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_14.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Not knowing exactly when you'd arrive, she had to leave without having the chance to welcome you in person.
:{{DIcon}} Why three days?
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_15.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Because she will require at least three days to complete her current task.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_16.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Madam Magistrate wanted to assure you that in three days, by any means, she will return to meet you in person.
::{{DIcon}} Is there anything I can do to help?
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_18.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' You...
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_19.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' I'll be sure to convey your kindness to Madam Magistrate. Please accept my sincerest gratitude.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_20.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Yes, Madam Magistrate does hope to have your assistance, but there is no rush for a decision. She does not want to pressure you into anything you may not desire. We invite you to learn about our situation before making a final commitment.
:{{DIcon}} How am I supposed to know what the tokens represent?
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_22.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' When it comes to these tokens, it is never her intention to confuse you with the puzzles. Instead, they should serve as clues that lead you toward the truth.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_23.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Madam Magistrate deeply regrets not having the time to deliver her messages to you in person.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_24.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' We value your presence far more than you might imagine. The same goes for any and all information about you.
:{{DIcon|Arrow}} Got it.
:{{DIcon}} How were you certain I was the guest?
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_26.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Since Madam Magistrate is currently away, I cannot make the final confirmation on her behalf.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_27.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' But you. You are truly exceptional.
:{{DIcon}} I heard many people were "politely" asked to leave.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_29.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Regarding that...
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_30.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' My eyes can see the frequencies of all living beings.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_31.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Or rather, those "frequencies" are the only thing I can see.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_32.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' You... You share the same frequency with Madam Magistrate.
:{{DIcon}} What does my frequency look like?
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_35.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' You look undistorted and authentic, in your original form.
:{{DIcon}} The same frequency?
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_36.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Apologies. My description was not accurate.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_37.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Both you and Madam Magistrate look undistorted to me.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_38.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' In my eyes, you appear the way you are.
:{{DIcon}} What do the frequencies of others look like?
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_22_40.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' They all look different.
:''For some reason, you can tell Sanhua doesn't want to continue this topic.''
----
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_23_60.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' May I have your Terminal for a moment?
:{{DIcon}} What do you want with it?
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_23_64.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' I need your Terminal for Access Pass authorization. In the meantime, I willconfigure the latest Utility module for you.
:{{DIcon}} My Terminal?
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_23_65.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Yes, it's the "gourd" on your waist. The device every [[Resonator]] carries.
:{{DIcon}} Are we exchanging contacts now?
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_23_66.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Indeed. It was an oversight on my end. I will now import my contact information and that of all public services, like [[Patrol Stations]], into your Terminal.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_23_67.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' I will be here on standby, ready to assist whenever you need me.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_23_68.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' I need your Terminal for regional access authorization. I will also configure the latest Utility module for you.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_23_69.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Madam Magistrate thought you might need it.
:{{DIcon}} (Hand over the Terminal.)
:''You waited for a moment.''
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_23_72.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' The Utility module on your Terminal has been upgraded to the latest iteration. Now all the Utilities, including Sensor, Levitator, and Grapple, should be fully functional.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_23_42.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' You are now granted unlimited access to all regions in Jinzhou. I have sent your Terminal ID to every border pass and resonance Beacon. You will only need to display your Terminal ID, or activate a Beacon with your Terminal for entry.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_23_73.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' You are now free to visit any part of Jinzhou.
:{{DIcon}} And that includes the City Hall?
:{{DIcon}} So no more annoying paperwork?
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_23_45.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Yes, including the City Hall. You have full access to its facilities.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_23_46.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Also, may I ask... Have you decided your place of residence in Jinzhou?
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_23_47.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' If not, Madam Magistrate has arranged accommodation for you in advance, here in the City Hall.
:{{DIcon}} Home sweet home.
:{{DIcon}} Royal Suite. Here I come!
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_23_52.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' I will lead you to your room if you need.
::{{DIcon}} That won't be necessary at the moment.
::{{DIcon}} I have friends waiting outside.
:{{DIcon}} That won't be necessary.
:{{DIcon}} I have other plans.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_23_58.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Understood. We will be ready to accommodate you anytime.

;(When the player talks to Sanhua again.)
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_1.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Anything I can help you with, Rover?
:{{DIcon}} I have questions about Jinzhou.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_7.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' With pleasure. What do you wish to know about Jinzhou?
::{{DIcon}} Who are the [[Midnight Rangers]]?
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_12.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' The [[Midnight Rangers]], under General [[Jiyan]]'s command, are a garrison in Jinzhou. They consist of the Vanguards for offensive operations against Tacet Discords, and the Rearguards for city defense.
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_49.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Additionally, there is a detachment unit called the Outriders, mostly made up of volunteers or reservists who serve as reconnaisance agents.
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_13.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Most of the servicement of today are comprised of Resonators.
::{{DIcon}} How about an introduction of the city?
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_16.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Jinzhou is not the most populated city in Huanglong. As a border city, it is the frontline in countering [[Tacet Discord]] Outbreaks.
:::{{DIcon}} Care to give me an introduction that's not from the books?
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_50.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' ...
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_51.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' ...Jinzhou holds a special place in my heart.
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_18.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' ...I can't say I am too familiar with my hometown, but I do feel a homely sense of attachment to Jinzhou. Maybe it's because here lives a person who changed my life.
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_19.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Hmm. If I were to introduce Jinzhou in my own words, I'd say it's a city one would easily grow attached to.
::{{DIcon|Back}} I still have other questions.
:{{DIcon}} I have questions about the Magistrate.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_21.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Of course. Please feel free to ask me anything, and I will answer to the best of my ability.
::{{DIcon}} I'd like to learn more about the Magistrate.
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_26.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Our Magistrate's birth name was Hsi. She took on the name [[Jinhsi]] when she became the Magistrate of Jinzhou.
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_27.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Nowadays, she is usually addressed as "Madam Magistrate."
::{{DIcon}} What is the relationship between Magistrate Jinhsi and the [[Jué|Sentinel of Jinzhou]]?
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_28.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' She is also known as the "Loong Maiden", because of her Resonance connection with our Sentinel, "[[Jué]]", who manifests in the shape of a {{Rubi|[[Loong]]|Dragon}}.
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_29.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' The ways Huanglong's Magistrates interact with their corresponding Sentinels can differ. In Jinzhou, our Magistrate seems to share a familial bond with the Sentinel.
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_31.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Though... This is what I understand from what she has told me. I have only seen our Sentinel a handful of times.
::{{DIcon}} When will the Magistrate return?
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_32.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' It depends on Madam Magistrate, and...
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_47.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' It depends on your decision, Rover.
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_48.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Please pardon me. This is all I can say at the moment.
::{{DIcon|Back}} I still have other questions.
:{{DIcon}} I have questions about the tokens.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_33.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' With pleasure. What do you wish to know about the tokens?
::{{DIcon}} How should I make use of the tokens?
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_39.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' I suggest looking into where these tokens come from.
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_40.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Examine their locations of origin, and explore the sites or past events they represent... Then you should uncover the message Madam Magistrate wanted to convey, and hopefully learn everything you want to know.
::{{DIcon}} Can I not investigate the tokens?
:::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_41.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Of course. It is fully up to you.
::{{DIcon|Back}} I still have other questions.
:{{DIcon}} I have questions about you.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_21.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' Of course. Please feel free to ask me anything, and I will answer to the best of my ability.
::{{DIcon}} Have we met before?
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_45.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' I'm afraid not. I have never seen you before.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_11_46.ogg}} '''Sanhua:''' If I had, I would never forget you.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Nothing in particular.

:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_12_1.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Rover!
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_12_2.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' It took you so long. What gives? Was our Magistrate a chatterbox?
:''You told Chixia and Yangyang about your conversation with Sanhua.''
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_12_4.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' So Madam Magistrate's not in the City Hall...
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_12_5.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} What's going on?
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_12_8.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' The wind is rising. In it, I sense disturbance and unrest.
:{{DIcon}} Why the long face, Yangyang?
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_12_9.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Hahaha. It sure is.
::{{A|Vo hlmq xz 3_5.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' ...Chixia.
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_12_11.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' The increasing [[Tacet Fields]], uncannily powerful Tacet Discords, and now, our Magistrate's absence...
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_12_12.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Plus... The mysterious Rover!
:{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_12_13.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' I'm afraid...
:{{DIcon}} Jinzhou might be in danger.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_12_18.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Well, we've reported to the City Hall, the Ministry of War, AND the Academy. We've done everything we can.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_12_19.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' I mean, this is Huanglong! And we're talking about Jinzhou, of all places! We've been through our fair share of unrest over the past thousand years, and we've made it together every time.
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_12_20.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' There's been TD outbreaks every year, but we can always trust General Jiyan, Madam Magistrate, and our Sentinel to have our backs! We're not ones to mess with!
::{{A|Vo hlmq m1_1_12_21.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' "United we stand, a bastion of might; one equals a legion, invulnerable in fight"... Well said, Chixia. 
:{{DIcon}} There's no need to worry.
